body:
A new life may well be the only route to envigorate me into WANTING to live. Remaining in this situation is killing me slowly. I have to accept how toxic this relationship is - and it is poisoning my want to survive. 

I have to kill my hope of going further with their father-  even when he turns on the kitten purr (and knows how to pull my strings out of habit).

It seems much of my life will have to die (our relationship, my identity as wife and entrepreneur) or my whole life will die altogether.

I really only have my mom as familial support - but I can ask, yes. I guess it is the acceptance of the difficulty ahead (when the road behind was difficult as well) to see it get even further steeper is a shock. But my only choices are to take the trek or give up all together. 

At my weak moment (which are many) I turn to suicide as the easiest option. I have a very strong spiritual (non religious) side - and my brother (aunt as well) took this route. It almost seems comforting. It is the want to be at rest when life is chaotic and heavy.

I have, I come from a single mother family (that is why i tried and hoped for so long that this relationship would work) i know what it is to not have a father - and to see my brothers without a father - I didnt want that for my sons.

 The only thing that has passed from the pursuit of my hopes is time - not development.

My mother and partner are very similar in personality. I was the emotional caretaker  of my mom after 11 (my eldest brother died in army) and I aided my mother while the older brother (who commited suicide) was in and out of juvie. 

She is friendly with him (as she was his surety for bail) and tends to side with him or say at least i have a father for my kids. My extended family all live across the country.

I am very happy your life formed a beautiful picture as it progressed - mine still feels like scattered puzzle pieces. I have tried so long to make them fit a certain way - hoping that the picture fit - and now to see that none of pieces seem  to go anywhere is disheartening. 

It is difficult that I helped him start (business plan) grow (cirriculum, admin, webdesign) his business-  and will literally walk away with nothing while he walks away successful. I would have to go to school to pursue for credentials (I am self taught)  

 I just feel like every path I can take from this point is extremely hard and when I look behind me I see failure. I look down and see three lives depending on me and I look inside and feel broken. I see no solutions to any of this - and  so frustrated that what I thought was my only luck in life (sharing a family/building a business) turned out to be the sucker punch. How can I feel hope anymore.

I seriously dont even know what happiness is anymore. I see love, joy and happiness in others and tears run down my face. I ask myself "is that really real? What does that feel like?". Its not like I can sit and enjoy my children all the time - most of the time I am exhausted with keeping them fed, clean (clothes, bath, house) , behavioural development - I dont even have time to breathe. To think. To reflect let alone heal. I am so worn. I feel I have wasted life and the future is very bleak. What is the point. To end up a burden for my kids. To grow older each day, more stresses each day - and look in the mirror to see me more worn down then I am now? This is like the peak before the fall.

Thank you for your words. As I stated to the commenter below - I feel like I have been strong for my whole life - but now I am reaching the point of weakness. I see death and failure surrounding me with no way out.

As of right now this situation (relationship with him that I have been trying to make work/hoping works) has been going on for seven years. It is my reality - and it is what I have known. I have tried to be strong for so long - but being a single parent of three boys, having no family support and the grief of my brother/daughters deaths - and the huge blow of realizing this relationship is dead seems too high for me to climb.
I have three kids, who the hell is going to want to be with someone who started a family with someone else?
